name: facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech_recognition/kaldi/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.create_KaldiDecoderConfig: create a KaldiDecoderConfig dataclass to configure beam search, lattice decoding, and acoustic scale options
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.build_KaldiDecoder: build a KaldiDecoder instance with a config, beam width, and optional nbest results for speech recognition
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.run_KaldiDecoder_generate: run the KaldiDecoder generate method to produce batch inferences from a fairseq model and sample input
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.run_KaldiDecoder_decode_one: run the decode_one method to decode single utterance logits into words using Kaldi FST and pykaldi recognizer
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.run_KaldiDecoder_decode: run the decode method to submit batch emissions for parallel decoding across multiple threads

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.create_kaldi_hlg_graph: create a Kaldi HLG decoding graph from an ARPA language model and fairseq vocabulary using the initalize_kaldi function
